title: Gochujang Fried Chicken Bowl
subtitle: Air-fried KFC, cleaned up. 8 min prep, 18 min cook.

ingredients.thai_market_tip: Buy the 500g tray at Tops or Villa. Trim visible fat hard — air-frying renders the rest.

ingredients.note: The crispy shell. Don't sub flour — cornstarch is non-negotiable for the crunch.

ingredients.thai_market_tip: Chung Jung One red tub, Korean aisle. Get the medium-spicy if there's a choice.

ingredients.note: For the glaze, on top of the marinade tbsp.
Oil cap — this is your tsp. Goes in the glaze.
Stir into glaze for extra heat without extra sugar.

substitutions.note: Higher protein, leaner. Brine 15 min in 1 tsp salt + 1 cup water first or it dries out in the air fryer.
Cuts ~180 kcal. Bowl gets lighter — feels less like takeout, but the chicken still carries it.
Real glaze loses some shine but cuts sugar.

steps.text: Toss chicken chunks with 1 tbsp soy and garlic powder. Sit 5 min.
Add cornstarch, toss until every piece is dry-coated, no wet patches. Pat any clumps apart.
Lay chicken in single layer, no touching. Air fry 12 min, flip at 7. Should be deep gold and crisp.
While chicken cooks: whisk gochujang, honey, rice vinegar, 1 tbsp soy, garlic, sesame oil, gochugaru in a large bowl.
Microwave rice packs per label (~90 sec each).
Tip hot chicken straight into glaze bowl. Toss until every piece is lacquered — work fast, glaze sets on contact.
Build bowls: rice, cucumber to one side, glazed chicken in the centre. Top with spring onion and sesame seeds.

serves_with.note: Free macros — 50g kimchi adds ~10 kcal, sharpens the bowl.
If hungry: jammy 6-min egg = +6g protein, +5g fat.

notes: The 'guilty pleasure within macro' play. Real KFC bowls run 900+ kcal and 25g fat from deep-frying. Air-frying with cornstarch (not flour) gets ~80% of the crunch at less than half the fat. Toss in glaze right out of the air fryer — heat = absorption. If you wait, the coating goes leather. Cornstarch dredge is the single most important step; skipping it gets you boring saucy chicken.
